source_documents.title: Photoexcitation Induced Twisted Intramolecular Charge Shuttle (TICS)

reference_evidence_units.quote: BODIPY 5 (a close analogue of 2) exhibited low quantum yields
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Synthesized experimental analogue of computed compound 2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source distinguishes experimental compound 5 from computational compound 2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Missing SI Table S3 is not independently verified.

reference_evidence_units.quote: enhancement of fluorescence intensities by up to ~6 times in 5
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Ethylene glycol/glycerol viscosity series, Figure 1g; 10 micromolar, excitation 380 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Increasing glycerol fraction increases target fluorescence up to approximately sixfold.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solvent composition and polarity also change; this is not a perfectly isolated viscosity intervention.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the low quantum yields of 5 were related to molecular rotations
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of the viscosity experiment compared with compound 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors associate target quenching with molecular rotation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The comparator supports but does not independently locate the target's rotating-state geometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a short decay lifetime of 3.0 ps
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Femtosecond transient absorption in chloroform, Figure 1i-k.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A short-lived stimulated-emission feature near 480 nm is assigned to an LE state.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The state assignment is interpretation of the observed spectral/kinetic feature.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a peak and a shoulder at 555 nm and 521 nm, respectively, and a much longer decay lifetime of 78.3 ps
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 5
reference_evidence_units.statement: A longer-lived excited-state absorption feature is observed with the stated wavelengths and lifetime.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Band resemblance to a BODIPY radical supports an assignment but is not unique chemical identification.

reference_evidence_units.quote: We thus attributed the second excited state to the TICS state
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of transient absorption and radical-band comparison.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign the longer-lived state to TICS and estimate an LE-to-TICS transition rate of 3.3 x 10^11 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: TICS is mapped to the broad CT family, not silently renamed ordinary TICT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the oscillator strength of the TICS conformation is almost zero
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Computed S1 potential-energy surface of the dimethyl analogue.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The computed analogue has a dark TICS minimum.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not assign its exact oscillator strength or barrier to target 5.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Target-specific viscosity response supports suppression of rotation-dependent quenching.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The target's transient absorption is assigned to TICS, within the existing broad CT family.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The target's state conversion and emission suppression support a bright/dark-state account; the exact f~0 calculation belongs only to compound 2.
